quotes.Frog and Toad Are Friends: From writing letters to going swimming, telling stories to finding lost buttons, Frog and Toad are always there for each other.
quotes.Frog and Toad Together: When Toad admires the flowers in Frog's garden, Frog gives him seeds to grow a garden of his own. When Toad bakes cookies, Frog helps him eat them. And when both Frog and Toad are scared, they are brave together.
quotes.Frog and Toad All Year: In winter, spring, summer, and fall, Frog and Toad are always together. From sledding in winter to eating ice cream on hot summer days, these two friends have fun the whole year round!
quotes.Days with Frog and Toad: They fly kites, celebrate Toad's birthday, and share the shivers when Frog tells a scary story.
